summary: Iter20 verification of two fixes on preview: (1) backend filter to hide admit_card/result from default /vacancies view + stats totals, (2) admin panel sanity. Backend: 8/8 pytest passing. Frontend: default 'सभी' (All) view no longer shows any Admit Card or Result cards; clicking vac-cat-admit_card and vac-cat-result chips correctly surfaces those items; clicking All hides them again. Admin panel on preview is fully working — /admin/login returns HTTP 200 with data-testid='admin-login-page', /admin redirects unauth users to /admin/login, login with admin@haryanaenterprises.com / Admin@123 lands on /admin and shows all 3 sidebar items (admin-nav-vacancies, admin-nav-seo, admin-nav-content). Any 404 the user is seeing must therefore be on the PRODUCTION host (haryana-solar-app.emergent.host) and needs a redeploy from preview.

minor.issue: Haryana filter does NOT exclude admit_card/result — returned 9 items with 2 admit_card entries. Review request explicitly listed this as a required guardrail. Fix: extend the `$nin: ['admit_card','result']` exclusion to the haryana branch as well (currently it is only applied when category is None or 'all').

action_items: Extend admit_card/result exclusion to category='haryana' branch of list_vacancies() in /app/backend/server.py (~line 594). Currently only the `if not category or category=='all'` branch adds the $nin filter; the haryana $or query does not, so haryana-tagged admit cards still leak into the Haryana category view.

Inform user: preview is 100% functional (admin routes, category filtering). The 404 they see is on the production URL (haryana-solar-app.emergent.host) — that domain needs a redeploy of the current preview build.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_vacancies: the exclusion filter only runs in the else-branch of the category logic; the haryana branch bypasses it and leaks admit_card/result items into the Haryana view (business regression per spec).
server.py is 1494 lines — should be split into routers (vacancies, auth, admin, seo, content) for maintainability. Flag for next iteration.
